name: Arizona 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Do hands-on projects in science, agriculture, health and civic engagement with adult mentors. Teens can apply for state teen leader groups, camps and shooting sports.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 8 to 18. Your local Extension office helps you join.
pay_detail: Not stated on the page. Ask your county office about fees.
deadline_text: Join through your local Cooperative Extension office.
how_to_apply: Call your local Extension office. Then make a profile to join as a youth member.
notes: Also open to younger kids; teen parts are the leader roles. State programs listed include a teen leadership group, shooting sports, STEM projects and a camp on 55 acres of pine forest. Dates were not posted on the program pages.
